headline: EU Proposes Raising Tariffs on Brazilian Imports, Including 10% on Aircraft
summary: The United States proposed new tariffs on Brazilian products, including a 10% levy on finished aircraft. Washington said Brasilia had not corrected what it calls unreasonable practices.
why: Brazil is a large exporter of goods including aircraft, and tariffs on its exports can affect trade flows and the Brazilian economy.
why_moved: Proposed US tariffs on Brazilian goods raise trade-cost concerns for exporters.
original_headline: EU propone aumentar aranceles sobre las importaciones de Brasil, incluido uno del 10% a aeronaves
